text: Idris has his driving test on May 14, third attempt. Really nervous about the roundabout bit. Text him good luck that morning.

Sophie's dad back in hospital with pneumonia. She's flying up to Leeds Thursday and staying the week. The consultant wants to keep him in at least until the scan on the 14th, and then they'll decide about rehab. Her brother Jonah can't get time off so it's all on her. She sounded calm but I don't think she's eating properly. Her kids are staying with their dad.
imogen results day aug 13 wants medicine at bristol. predicted AAA

Jonah said his manager Dimitri is leaving at the end of June and nobody knows who's taking over the team. He's quietly hoping it's him. Apparently interviews will be internal first, sometime in July, and HR will announce the shortlist the week before. Jonah's worried his client numbers dipped in spring when he was off with his back. He's going to talk to Dimitri about a reference before he goes.
Elif sprained her ankle at netball, on crutches for two weeks. Her cat Pasha keeps tripping her up apparently.
So Anjali finally passed her ACCA exam, the tax one she failed twice. Massive. Need to send her congrats and maybe a bottle of something.
Barbara's grandson Tiago has his grade 5 piano exam on 6/3. She's been taking him to practice every day after school.
Femi - new client from Lisbon, Ricardo Lopez, very particular about decks. Hates slides with more than three bullets. Prefers calls before 10am.
chantal off sick again, migraines. third time this month. her boss Olga not impressed. check in w her fri
Olga mentioned her son Kemal got into the regional youth orchestra, audition was in March. First chair viola. She's thrilled.
Pick up prescription, return the library books, book car MOT before the 28th.
Jorge's knee surgery is booked for October 30. He'll be off work six weeks afterwards. Should drop round with food the day after, his wife Ines works nights.

Carlos and Natasha both sitting the bar exam July 28th. They've been revising together every evening. Natasha is way more stressed than he is. She's taken unpaid leave for the last two weeks and keeps saying she'll quit law if she fails. Results come out in November. Carlos says they're going to Portugal the week after the exam to recover, then straight back to work. Wish them both luck the day before.

Okay voice note. Just got off the phone with Jess. Her little girl Ava has chicken pox so the party on Saturday is off, they'll rearrange. Jess sounds absolutely shattered, hasn't slept properly in days. I said I'd drop off calpol and some colouring books tomorrow. Also she mentioned Ava's been obsessed with dinosaurs lately, which is useful for her birthday in December.
Elena's audition for the Guildhall drama course is 11/9. Callbacks a week after if she gets through. Remind me to ask how it went.
Leah: allergic to shellfish, vegetarian mostly, loves bouldering. Her partner is Santiago.
Jaya's mum had a fall last night, broke her wrist. Jaya's driving down to Cardiff this weekend to help out.
Must ring Hiroshi before his PhD viva on December 2nd. He's been dreading it since the summer.
Ming got the promotion!! Senior designer from November 1. Her team lead Anan pushed hard for it apparently.

Arjun's appraisal went badly, the new manager wants him on a performance plan. He's thinking about looking elsewhere. Follow up with him next week to see how he's feeling. The plan runs for ninety days, review on January 12th. His wife Leah says he's barely sleeping. He mentioned a recruiter from a fintech in Manchester got in touch, interview might be early December. Don't push him either way.
Abebe told me his daughter starts her GCSE mocks the Monday after half term. She's revising at the kitchen table till midnight.
Dentist 9:15 Tuesday. Then gym. Then call the insurance people about the claim.
Joseph Evans from accounts retiring on March 31. Collection going round, card is in Femi's drawer. Don't forget to sign it and put a tenner in.
Ines said Tiago's tonsils are coming out on Jan 8. He's six and terrified of needles. She'll be off work that week and the week after.
meeting w santiago re: the Khan account. client wants everything by 4/15. santiago thinks thats insane. i'm doing the forecast section, he's doing slides
Natasha passed!! Bar results came out this morning. Carlos didn't, he's gutted. Maybe take him out for a pint next week, don't make a big thing of it.
Sophie's dad is out of hospital, home since Monday. Still very weak though. She said the next few weeks are about getting his strength back.
Quick one. Dimitri's flying to Frankfurt for the Schmidt pitch on the 22nd. Wants me to review his slides the day before.
Kemal Yilmaz (Kem) - plays five a side Wednesdays, supports Galatasaray, just started an apprenticeship as an electrician.
Elif's ankle is still bad, physio says it might be a ligament tear. MRI on November 4th. She's fed up, missing the netball season.

Imogen didn't get the grades for Bristol, got into Leeds through clearing instead. Starts September 21. Her mum is more upset than she is honestly. Should send her a card with something for her new flat.
Jonah's interview for the team lead role is Thursday at 2. Panel is Dimitri and someone from HR. He wants to do a mock with me Wednesday evening.
Anan was signed off with stress for a month. Came back today, seemed okay but quiet. Partner is Hiroshi who mentioned they're going to Japan for Christmas to see his parents.
Leah's practical driving test, March 3rd at 8:40. If she passes she's buying her nan's old Fiesta.
Barbara said her husband Joseph had a mild stroke last week. He's home now, speech a bit slurred. She's coping but tired. Should I take round a lasagne Sunday?
Chantal mentioned her son Femi has his first ever school play on 12/10, he's a shepherd. Afterwards they're going for pizza.
Note to self: renew passport before April. Expires June 9.

Talked to Ricardo about the delayed launch. His boss wants a post-mortem by Friday. He reckons someone in his team is going to get blamed, probably Ines who's only been there two months. The client, Mr Khan, has been surprisingly decent about it. New launch date is April 7, with a dry run the Thursday before. Ricardo is going to be in Madrid for most of that week anyway, so he wants me on the call.
Arjun's sister Jaya is sitting her midwifery finals on May 20th. Their mum keeps calling her to check she's eating.
Natasha's admission ceremony is on November 18 in London. Carlos is going with her, they're doing dinner after.
Jorge did the op this morning, all went fine. He's groggy. Text him tomorrow to see how he's doing, and ask Ines if they need anything.
elena got thru to callbacks!! callback is the following monday. she's buzzing but also panicking. send her a good luck msg the night before
Ava Banerjee, new starter in our team. Came from Deloitte. Runs marathons, doing London in April. Has a whippet called Biscuit.
Hiroshi's viva was yesterday, passed with minor corrections! Doctor Suzuki now. He said he's sleeping for a week.
Femi wants a couple of days off around March 5 because his dad is having a hip replacement on the 4th and he wants to be there that morning and the day after.
Ming's brother Anan sat the civil service fast stream test last week, results due around the 30th.

Dictated walking home: so Idris failed again, on the roundabout, exactly what he was worried about. He's rebooked for 7/22 but honestly he sounded really low, said he might give up and just get the bus forever. His girlfriend Elena is going to do practice drives with him at weekends. I should message him in a few days, not now, and maybe offer to go out in the car with him too.
Santiago's twins have their swimming gala next Saturday. Both have been training before school all month.
Jess got her blood test results back, iron is super low. GP has her on supplements, retest in six weeks. She's been exhausted for ages so at least it's an answer.
Olga's mum is being moved to a care home on the 1st. Olga is struggling with it, keeps saying she feels guilty. Check in on her the week after.

Good chat with Abebe about the reorg. His whole department is being merged with procurement, redundancy consultations start 10/27. He's fairly calm but his wife isn't. They've just remortgaged and their eldest is starting uni next September, so the timing is awful. He's updating his CV this weekend and asked if I'd look at it afterwards. Also his boss Elena is leaving, which nobody saw coming.
Kemal said Elif's birthday is May 2nd. She's been on about wanting a proper film camera, the Olympus one.
Carlos resits the bar in February. Plans to cut down to four days a week at work to study.

long call w chantal. she's been asked to cover olga's role while olga is on leave from june 3 to sept. more money but no extra help. olga's operation is the june 5 and recovery is long. chantal's nervous about managing people who used to be her peers. i said i'd help her plan her first week, sunday afternoon
Tiago is home from hospital, ate an entire tub of ice cream the next day. Ines says he's fine now, back at school Monday.
Barbara's granddaughter Jaya is getting married on August 16! Barbara wants help finding an outfit. Must go shopping with her before end of June.
Rain all day. Did nothing. Need to sort the boiler before winter.
Dr Patel said Dimitri's back problem is a slipped disc. He's working from home until at least 9/30 and can't sit for long.
Jonah got the team lead job! Starts officially on Monday the 3rd. Remind me to buy him a coffee that first morning.
Leah passed her theory test on the first go. Practical booked for the end of March. She was so nervous about the hazard perception bit.
